bio: Noltis walks the Dark Passage, the tunnels deep beneath the city of Shadespire where her sect studies the archives of the ancient Nocturna. But Noltis is not satisfied to simply preserve those histories – she wields both magic and memory to reforge the Nocturna into something greater than they were.
